prompt: RFC 9114 HTTP/3 SETTINGS values variable-length integer bit sizes
answer:
RFC 9114 HTTP/3 SETTINGS **values** are QUIC variable-length integers encoded using one of these bit sizes:

| Bit size | Encoding length |
|---:|---:|
| 6 bits | 1 byte |
| 14 bits | 2 bytes |
| 30 bits | 4 bytes |
| 62 bits | 8 bytes |

Both the SETTINGS identifier and value are encoded as QUIC variable-length integers.
